props.content:
Skapie Extensions — author a kit package offline

A kit package is a folder kits/<id>/ with kit.json:
schemaVersion: 1, id (same as folder), displayName,
description (optional), capabilities: [], objects: [].
Each object: typeId (box, text, button, debug.rect), x, y, width, height, props.

Add a tool by setting props.toolName on an object and cabling Output to the LLM Tools port. The host must own that runner.

Local docs: docs/kit_author.md, docs/kit_api.md, docs/kit_packages.md
